answer: Sybil clones cheap-fill peer lists. Bind each new agent to a ferrous stake coupon whose serial is a quartz Merkle leaf of (device-attestation||epoch). Capacity unlocks only after 6 distinct peers route work packets across a shared ocean of rate-limited channels. Cost: 25 POA plus 90s of unique PoW. Verification: ledger rejects a second leaf under the same coupon. On failure (replayed leaf or idle coupon >12h), burn 60% of the stake and freeze the leaf for 15 epochs.
